definitions.explanation: A licensed healthcare professional who provides medical care and support to patients in hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare settings.

examples.japanese: {看護師|かんごし}になるには{国家試験|こっかしけん}に{合格|ごうかく}しなければならない。
examples.english: To become a nurse, you must pass the national exam.

examples.japanese: {看護師|かんごし}さんが{毎日|まいにち}{血圧|けつあつ}を{測|はか}ってくれる。
examples.english: The nurse measures my blood pressure every day.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{大学病院|だいがくびょういん}で{看護師|かんごし}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: She works as a nurse at a university hospital.

notes:
{看護師|かんごし} is the modern, gender-neutral term for nurse that replaced the older terms {看護婦|かんごふ} (female nurse) and {看護士|かんごし} (male nurse) in 2002.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {看護師|かんごし}になる (to become a nurse)
- {看護師|かんごし}として{働|はたら}く (to work as a nurse)
- {看護師|かんごし}を{目指|めざ}す (to aim to become a nurse)
- {正看護師|せいかんごし} (registered nurse)
- {准看護師|じゅんかんごし} (practical nurse)

USAGE NOTES:
- Often addressed or referred to as {看護師|かんごし}さん when speaking to or about a nurse respectfully.
